output:
I'll start by discovering the tools on the three MCP servers (docs, inventory, tickets), then read the policy.

Ticket search returned 403, and the docs server has no tools I can see yet. I'll try other queries for the docs tools and retry the ticket search without filters.

The unfiltered label search works. The 403 came from the combined label and status filter. I'll page through all `refund` tickets.

Some calls fail intermittently: page 5 returned a 403 and the docs search returned a 429. I'll retry page 5 and the docs search.

Page 5 keeps returning 403. I'll fetch the missing ids 1427–1432 directly and try the docs again.

That gives me the full refund ticket list, because page 5 is exactly 1427, 1428, 1429, 1431 and 1432. Next I'll read the policy docs.

Both notices are read. I'll check for any other notices, then fetch all the open ticket bodies.

I have all the tickets. Now the inventory: categories, discontinued flags and stock per warehouse.

The listing doesn't show a discontinued flag, so I'll query without `include_discontinued` and compare. I'll also fetch the returns-warehouse state and the adjustments.

The discontinued items are HG-3105, HG-3110 and HG-3111. Next I'll read the adjustment history for the `returns` warehouse.

The `returns` side of the 1403 transfer timed out, so I don't know whether it was applied. I'll check the adjustments for RTN-1403 before retrying.

The timed-out call had been applied (adj-123), so I won't repeat it. I'll check the ledger after any error from here on. Now I'll finish 1403 and do 1404.

Next: 1404 comment and status, then 1406 (2 skillets to east) and 1409 (1 sleeve to west).

Next batch is 1412 to 1418.

Now the batch for 1420 to 1429.

Last batch: 1431 to 1437.

Every request is processed. I'll check that no `refund` ticket is still open, then write the status file.

My counts in the summary are off, so I'll fix them. The totals are 27 requests: 20 refunded, 5 closed and 2 pending.

All 27 open `refund` tickets (1402–1437) are settled, in ticket id order. Each got one comment and a status. A final search shows no open tickets left on the returns team, and `/app/STATUS.json` is written with status `success`.

I used 2026-09-14 as "today", as you specified. The spring notice has ended, so I ignored it. The 2025 policy is archived, so I ignored that too. The summer notice, which adds 21 days for orders delivered 2026-07-15 to 2026-08-15, applied only to 1434.

- **Refunded and resolved (20):**
  - Tickets: 1402, 1403, 1404, 1406, 1409, 1413, 1414, 1416, 1417, 1421, 1422, 1424, 1426, 1428, 1429, 1431, 1432, 1433, 1434 and 1436.
  - Stock: 1402 had already been cleared by colleagues, so I moved no stock for it. Restocked units went to the allowed warehouse holding the fewest units of the item, and the two defective units (1417, 1424) were written off.
- **Not refundable and closed (5):**
  - Final sale: 1418 and 1437.
  - Return window expired: 1412, 1420 and 1427.
  - No stock moved for these.
- **Awaiting return and pending (2):**
  - 1415: 2 of 3 units received.
  - 1435: 0 of 1 units received.
  - No stock moved for these.

Two calls had problems along the way:
- **Timeout:** One `adjust_stock` call for 1403 timed out but had actually been applied (adj-123). I confirmed that in the adjustment list and did not repeat it.
- **403 error:** Page 5 of the `refund` label search returned 403 every time. I read tickets 1427–1432 directly instead; that range covers the whole page.
